summary: Bilateral perihilar/mid-lung haziness present on prior is substantially clearer on current, with better-defined vascular markings.

findings.rationale: Prior shows diffuse bilateral hazy, ill-defined perihilar and mid-lung opacification obscuring vessels; current shows the same anatomic zones (matched by ribs/hila) with sharper vascular margins and more aerated lung. Caveat: differing line/tube positions and slight rotation between exams limit precise comparison.
